rationale: Desvenlafaxine to venlafaxine: Desvenlafaxine IS the active metabolite of venlafaxine (O-desmethylvenlafaxine). This is essentially a formulation/prodrug switch within the same pharmacological class. The pharmacokinetic overlap is favourable — both drugs act on the same targets (SERT + NET). Discontinuation syndrome risk is high for both. Approach: start venlafaxine at approximate equivalent dose, then taper desvenlafaxine. Dose conversion: desvenlafaxine 50 mg ≈ venlafaxine 75 mg (approximate; individual variation expected). Both carry high discontinuation syndrome risk — never stop either abruptly. The switch should be smooth given the pharmacological similarity. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

schedule.notes: Start venlafaxine XR 75 mg. Continue desvenlafaxine 50 mg. Pharmacologically very similar switch — smooth transition expected. No serotonin syndrome risk of clinical concern at these doses.
Assess tolerability on dual SNRI. If excess side effects (tachycardia, sweating, nausea), reduce desvenlafaxine sooner.

Stop desvenlafaxine. Continue venlafaxine XR 75 mg. If stopping desvenlafaxine causes discontinuation symptoms, use a slower taper (50 mg → 25 mg for 1 week → stop). Titrate venlafaxine to 150 mg at 4 weeks if response inadequate.
